title: On Hurting his hand on the broken glass
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：hurt　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hurt 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the foreman ① hurt his hand on the broken glass at once, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② hurts his hand on the broken glass in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hurt his hand on the broken glass at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hurt his hand on the broken glass before — a line in the sheet for May 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hurting his hand on the broken glass at once, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hurt his pride more than anything in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hurt his pride more than anything at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ hurts his pride more than anything at once every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hurt his hand on the broken glass again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hurt his hand on the broken glass, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody hurts his hand on the broken glass in the rain again and somebody must hurt his hand on the broken glass at once all over again.

B. v. 弄伤（一般现在 hurts his hand on the broken glass：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 弄伤（不定式 to hurt his hand on the broken glass：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 弄伤（过去完成时 had hurt his hand on the broken glass：1951 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 弄伤（动名词 hurting his hand on the broken glass 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）

answers.why: hurt 意为“弄伤”，1957 年工头二话不说地弄伤被碎玻璃划伤了手，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hurt。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，自那以后工头淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hurts。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯弄伤被碎玻璃划伤了手”，此处为不定式 to hurt his hand on the broken glass。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人弄伤过，故用过去完成时 had hurt。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，工头说“弄伤被碎玻璃划伤了手这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hurting his hand on the broken glass 作主语。
hurt 意为“刺痛”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去刺痛伤得最重的是他的自尊”，should ever 之后用原形 hurt his pride more than anything。
hurt 意为“刺痛”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻刺痛伤得最重的是他的自尊（hurt his pride more than anything at once），以后再也不要提起。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，新来的工人每个班次都照例刺痛伤得最重的是他的自尊，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hurts。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地弄伤被碎玻璃划伤了手，用一般过去式 hurt 叙述。
hurt 意为“弄伤”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要弄伤被碎玻璃划伤了手，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hurt 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the foreman hurt his hand on the broken glass at once, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman hurts his hand on the broken glass in the rain whenever the site asks.
Hurting his hand on the broken glass at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hurt his pride more than anything in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site hurts his pride more than anything at once every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hurt his hand on the broken glass again, and the site remembered that half.
